audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side reads "Skill" on every one of the 7 rows while content win[] already says Miss Fortune wins levels 1-3, 6 and first item, and Seraphine wins 2+ items. The two layers disagree on who wins each stage.
audit.why: Double Up (Q, 7/6/5/4/3s cd) bounces off the caster minion or Seraphine for heavy poke, and Love Tap taxes every farm swap, so Miss Fortune wins early. Seraphine's Q-W-E kit only evens levels 4-5, and only pulls ahead once Encore can charm-cancel Bullet Time at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: phases[0-2,4,5].side -> Miss Fortune; phases[6].side -> Seraphine; phases[3] stays Skill. Ratings and whys rewritten to match (see edits).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Bullet Time as matchup-defining but carries no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Bullet Time is 120/110/100s, her Q pokes on a 7-3s cycle, Seraphine's E is 11-9s and R is 160/140/120s. Concrete numbers let a reader time the window instead of just being told to 'respect' it.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real numbers for both R's and the E/Q cycle.

audit.why: Bullet Time is flagged channel/interruptible — any CC cancels it, and Seraphine's R (Encore) is hardCC. The existing dosFull/report text already correctly identifies Encore as the counter to a clumped Bullet Time; this is the decisive interaction and it is present, just mis-titled bodies elsewhere (see lint fixes).
